findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: preview_endpoint, fetch_webpage, fetch_webpage_pro, get_contents, search_web, search_images, search_places, search_discussions, detect_tech, company_profile · Private data: extract_pdf, domain_intel, company_profile · Public sink: company_profile · Destructive: preview_endpoint, detect_tech.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: preview_endpoint, fetch_webpage, fetch_webpage_pro, get_contents, search_web, search_images, search_places, search_discussions, detect_tech, company_profile · Private data: extract_pdf, domain_intel, company_profile · Public sink: company_profile · Destructive: preview_endpoint, detect_tech

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
